claim: For a registered finite-area task relative to a fixed reference, B can reject every allowed exterior compensation at a budget for which A has an independently audited hiding witness, under equal acquisition contracts.
operator: released nominal n32/n96_f400_a08, scalar TM, 400 MHz, identical spectrum and 24-port loads across A/B
hardware: 8 shots, 64 complex reads and total 1 W available per layout, 50 ohm matching/termination, equal exposures, eight fixed terminated hold ports
noise: original public joint Frobenius radius r for each layout, prospective separation threshold 2r, actual compatibility threshold r when an actual noisy observation exists

reference_tasks.joint32: n32_c02 saved joint fit roi_zero_x and published roi_02 from the prior public aperture control
reference_tasks.air32: known exact air blank, original n32_c02 noise scale, same query ROI
reference_tasks.air96: known exact air blank, original n96_c02 noise scale, 3 by 3 replication of the 32-cell query mask only; native operator and material recomputation
reference_tasks.native96: n96_c02 saved public GN zero fit and public native roi_02; B is prospective only

beta_parameter: contrast; convert to ||e||_L1 cap = beta times exterior area, ||e||_L2 cap = beta times sqrt exterior area, ||e||_max cap = beta; also report those norms for each witness
interior: primary fixed flat task c+t on all ROI cells; independent shape-free task mean(x_R-c_R) >= t, all ROI cells independently within original material box
scope: Fixed calibrated instrument and fixed reference only; no truth or clean target observations are read
